title: Report a problem
safety: Gas smell, sparking or water near electrics? Leave the area and call 999, then the office.
noUnits: No unit is linked to your account yet. Contact the office.
degradedTriage: The manager will set the category and priority.
expiryRule: This draft expires 24 hours after it was prepared.
consequence: Nothing is sent until you confirm. The manager checks the category and priority.
sentDetail: The office has your report. Status: Reported.
offline: You are offline. Your text and captures are kept. Reconnect to continue.
unavailable: This report is not available to you
stale: This draft changed. Reload it to check the latest details. Your edits are kept.
decided: This draft has already been decided. Current status: {status}.
couldNotLoad: Could not load. Your text and captures are kept. Try again.
uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Your capture is kept. Retry the upload.
invalidInput: Check your report details, then try again.
limitExceeded: This file exceeds the upload limit. Use a smaller photo or a shorter voice note.
unsupportedType: This file type is not supported. Record a voice note or take a photo.
mediaNotReady: Your files are still being checked. Wait a moment, then retry.
mediaInUse: These files already belong to a report. Open your existing report or record new media.
uploadMismatch: The upload could not be verified. Your capture is kept. Retry the upload.
uploadNotFound: The upload was not found. Your capture is kept. Retry the upload.
keyReused: This command has different details. Reload the draft before trying again.
minText: Type at least 3 characters before sending.
noLocalPreview: This attachment is saved with the report. Its preview is unavailable on this device.
captureFailed: Could not capture this file. Try again.
syntheticTranscript: Synthetic report: water is leaking under the kitchen sink.
retryDecision: Retry the pending decision before editing or discarding.
